DELETE FROM EDS.DEP_STOPPAYMENTADDTNLTABLE WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_STOPPAYMENTADDTNLTABLE);

INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_STOPPAYMENTADDTNLTABLE
(
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,acid
    ,begin_chq_num
    ,rec_type
    ,sp_srl_num
    ,bank_id
    ,valid_from
    ,valid_to
    ,instruction_mode
    ,auto_renewal
    ,num_of_renewals
    ,is_expired
    ,entity_cre_flg
    ,del_flg
    ,rcre_user_id
    ,rcre_time
    ,lchg_user_id
    ,lchg_time
    ,ts_cnt
    ,link_srl_num
    ,link_begin_chq_num
    ,link_end_chq_num
    ,chrg_coll_flg
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,acid
    ,begin_chq_num
    ,rec_type
    ,sp_srl_num
    ,bank_id
    ,valid_from
    ,valid_to
    ,instruction_mode
    ,auto_renewal
    ,num_of_renewals
    ,is_expired
    ,entity_cre_flg
    ,del_flg
    ,rcre_user_id
    ,rcre_time
    ,lchg_user_id
    ,lchg_time
    ,ts_cnt
    ,link_srl_num
    ,link_begin_chq_num
    ,link_end_chq_num
    ,chrg_coll_flg
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_STOPPAYMENTADDTNLTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'
    AND CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
